study.question: After relation-specific content and rank compression, does preserving which item content received historical feedback improve prediction beyond feedback rates and generic added linear maps?
study.hypothesis: Shared signed linear sums concatenate item and action embeddings but do not explicitly retain their event-level binding. Historical-feedback-conditioned item summaries inside each target-match/time unit expose this association before 32-dimensional compression. If that binding matters, actual conditional item content H should outperform rate-times-content F at equal nominal capacity. This revisits content association, not the unsuccessful count-only mechanism.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary text lines250-277 describes target-dependent unnormalized weighted pooling. Inherit that local-activation sum; add historical feedback-conditioned item-content access within fixed time/relation bins, with an independence replacement control. This is not a new claim for target-aware pooling.

Pinned benchmark source lines123-159 initializes task sequence hubs using multi_masks with task-specific projections and averages, then aggregates/broadcasts. Adapt mask-conditioned item summarization only: retain signed target weights, overlapping target relations and five time bins; fuse into existing tokens using maps shared over bins/relations. No task hubs, hub broadcasting, per-layer sequence updates or INFNet reproduction.

Pinned tokenizer and per-token FFN paths inspected. Inherit the existing local relation-heterogeneous compression from the parent; this study adds feedback-conditioned item statistics rather than field/task-token FFNs. The original paper is link-only in the registry; novelty relative to full literature remains unverified.

Pinned forward/tokenizer paths inspected: fields, event history and target have direct token access. The candidate keeps compressed summaries and does not add full/window event attention or claim to reproduce TokenFormer. Direct event modeling remains an alternative to this limited summary repair.
Original paper provenance resolved, but detailed primary text unavailable; fallback benchmark text/code inspected. No original-paper equivalence, priority or transferred effectiveness claim.

inherited_components: All g0-r0009-relation_content architectural components and frozen feature/mask handling; source SHA256 88068454305d892294ebacac1526fd40988b729392f12fa89996af9585963224
DIN-style signed target local activation, overlapping encoded-field matches and global plus four valid-rank quartiles
Content/count slots, full linear-rank summaries, shared/duplicate moment projections, relation-specific moment/content maps, one JointBlock and four towers
Historical multi-task masks are already authorized inputs; using them in a new pooled item-content path does not change visibility
Task-mask-conditioned aggregation is an existing mechanism in the inspected INFNet benchmark; the controlled adaptation here is not a priority claim
study.proposed_difference: Let R[t,r,i] be the inherited relation/bin mask, m[a,i] the official historical task mask intersected with valid, w[i] the inherited signed local weight and x[i] only the six item-field embeddings (96 dimensions; omit action embedding in the new path). S=sum_i R*w*x/sqrt(7), p_a=sum_i R*m_a/max(1,sum_i R), H_a=sum_i R*m_a*w*x/sqrt(7), F_a=p_a*S. Add sum_a source_a @ E[a] into the existing token before JointBlock. E has shape[4,96,32], shared over bins/relations. Joint uses H, factorized uses F, duplicate uses S, zero computes H then suppresses projected output. All E start at zero after inherited initialization. FP32 summary accumulation is common to every arm. No new tokens, loss hook, input, optimizer or label are introduced.
predictions: Primary: feedback_bound exceeds feedback_factorized in full-validation equal-weight four-task macro AUC. A positive difference in one seed is provisional controlled evidence for this implementation, not significance or repeated support.
feedback_bound also exceeds feedback_duplicate and the replayed parent if extra association access is useful; improvement only over zero is insufficient to attribute a mechanism.

Holding learned weights and representations fixed at the summary operator, masks with identical rates can yield different H while F stays fixed. Constant weighted item content within a relation gives H=F; all-zero/all-one feedback, singleton relations and empty histories give the expected equivalences.
Direction may be larger in nonempty/long histories than sparse histories, but existing length slices are secondary exploratory diagnostics; no post hoc slice changes can override macro-AUC selection.
falsifiers: No macro-AUC gain of feedback_bound over feedback_factorized leaves the binding hypothesis unsupported under this recipe, even if both beat zero.
Matching or losing to feedback_duplicate suggests added optimization/parameterization can explain the gain; a superior factorized control supports rate-content interaction instead of event binding.

If all-active masks/constant weighted-content conditions violate H=F beyond declared FP32 tolerance, if padding/current-label perturbations affect outputs, or the zero path fails fixed-state equivalence to parent, stop for integrity/debugging before interpreting scores.

A small gain that changes direction on authorized paired-seed assessment, or lacks acceptable measured cost, prevents a stable mechanism or efficiency claim. No new performance is established in this proposal phase.
alternative_explanations: Four task-specific maps may improve optimization independently of feedback-content association; duplicate and zero distinguish active reparameterization and replay, but duplicate has smaller functional capacity.

H and F share nominal parameters but differ in sparsity, input scale, gradient covariance and effective functional dimension. Their difference is a controlled operational test of association access, not unique identification of semantic causality.

Historical action embeddings already encode feedback mixtures, and the prior feedback-count branch was negative. Binding may be redundant, too rare, or poorly optimized in one pass; a failed version does not refute all feedback-conditioned models.
Parent content-bank gains were obtained on the same validation and seed; adaptive validation selection and unknown seed variation can inflate apparent differences.

FP32 recomputation of S is mathematically redundant with the item portion of the inherited summary but can differ from BF16 grouped pooling. This precision difference is common to new arms; diagnose against fixed-state parent and do not attribute zero-replay drift to new information.
Official offline delayed-feedback visibility, encoded-ID collisions, static snapshots and auxiliary user/category/brand 24h labels limit production and advertisement-conversion interpretations.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Own committed full-unit receipts: g0-r0009-relation_content 408.245s wall,367.533s training,31.419s inference,6811129856 peak GPU bytes; g0-r0009 controls408.071-414.642s wall. New cost is an estimate, not measured.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: At snapshot remaining23336.326s, reserve up to3600s for these four full units including all checks/failures/scoring (conservative900s each), plus3600s for a discriminating follow-up or replay attribution if needed. All preparation and emulator costs count. Added nominal parameters12288 (predicted total33014405, dense1221189). At B8192,L100,5*7 slots,K96,D32, new forward has five FP32 summary bmm calls (~13.76 billion MACs) and four small projection matmuls (~3.523 billion MACs); repeated masks/summaries cost memory and backward work. This is operation accounting, not equal-compute evidence.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Keep at least6000s uncommitted for host-authorized validation-only paired repetitions of selected candidate and closest controls (target three paired seeds when allowed), including final cost/attribution checks. Current training seed is frozen; do not put seeds/epochs or host parameters into candidate config. No held-out test is available. If later paired scheduling is unavailable, explicitly retain single-seed conclusions.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No training is launched in propose phase. Host must check live ledger before any full unit; stop if no complete admissible unit plus reserved checks/assessment fits, on hard limit, stop instruction or integrity failure. Never raise the limit. A >900s trial cost triggers a live budget/cost reassessment before further variants. No unknown-state automatic duplicate execution. Failed forward/backward checks and retries stay charged.
